description: Source code implementing the FramebufferMtl class for Metal renderer in ANGLE project, handling framebuffer operations such as clear, invalidate, readPixels, and render pass management.

classes.name: FramebufferMtl
classes.description: Class managing framebuffer operations for Metal renderer, including clearing, invalidation, reading pixels, and render pass setup.

methods.name: GetReadAttachmentInfo
methods.description: Retrieves internal format info for the read attachment.

methods.name: readPixelsImpl
methods.description: Implements pixel readback from the framebuffer.

methods.name: getColorReadRenderTarget
methods.description: Returns the current color attachment used for reading pixels.

methods.name: getCompleteRenderArea
methods.description: Returns the full render area of the framebuffer.

methods.name: getRenderPassDesc
methods.description: Returns the current render pass descriptor.

methods.name: onStartedDrawingToFrameBuffer
methods.description: Prepares load/store actions when starting to draw to the framebuffer.

methods.name: updateColorRenderTarget
methods.description: Updates the cached color render target.

methods.name: updateDepthRenderTarget
methods.description: Updates the cached depth render target.

methods.name: updateStencilRenderTarget
methods.description: Updates the cached stencil render target.

methods.name: updateCachedRenderTarget
methods.description: Caches the render target for a given attachment.

methods.name: prepareRenderPass
methods.description: Prepares the render pass descriptor based on current framebuffer state.

methods.description: Overrides clear color based on texture write mask.

methods.description: Performs the clear operation, deciding between load/store or draw.
